flagged_categories.message:
Context: This update looks at Synthetic Flagged revenue in August vs. July. Any month-on-month change above 8.0% in either direction is reviewed.
Insight: [Fact] Synthetic Flagged revenue rose from INR 50,000.00 in July to INR 60,000.00 in August, a change of 20.0%. [Fact] Orders went from 25 to 30 over the same period.
Implication: [Hypothesis] The rise may reflect a August-specific demand driver, such as a promotion or seasonal push, because orders and revenue moved together; the figures alone do not show why. [Action] Ask the regional leads whether any Synthetic Flagged promotion or seasonal stocking ran in August; if none did, find another explanation before August is used as a planning baseline. [Action] Split August's INR 60,000.00 by order status (delivered, returned, cancelled, pending); if delivered revenue is much lower, treat the 20.0% change as overstated.
